content: Evolution API instance state is 'connecting' | 'open' | 'close' with a numeric statusReason. GET /instance/connectionState/:instance returns it. QR codes expire in ~45s with configurable max regenerations; qrcode.updated webhook fires on refresh. statusReason 401/403/402/406 (logout, banned, payment, invalid session) = NO auto-reconnect, requires re-pairing; 408/428/500 (timeout, connection lost, server error) = auto-reconnect with exponential backoff. connection.update webhook payload carries state, statusReason, wuid, profileName. Endpoints: DELETE /instance/logout/:name, DELETE /instance/delete/:name, POST /instance/connect/:name. Auth is two-tier: global AUTHENTICATION_API_KEY (full access to ALL instances) vs per-instance token returned as 'hash' on creation, passed via the 'apikey' header.
